task: FV2-034 — Flutter older TEXT and DM history errors stay inline and retryable
summary: Flutter now presents older-page TEXT and DM failures within the history list, keeps the existing cursor, and exposes a retry action matching the web clients.

checks.name: Test-first TEXT baseline
checks.command: cd clients/flutter && flutter test test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name 'keeps older text-page failures inline and retryable'
